title: The Pool of Six
text: A still pool at the Shrine is ringed with six pale stones. To each person who looks in, it shows the god who favors them, a face rising up out of the dark. Some see nothing at all, and walk away very quiet.

options.label: Each Scion looks into the pool, to learn which god favors them.

outcomes.text: They see only dark water and their own face, alone.

options.label: The devout one drinks from the pool, taking the gods into themselves.

outcomes.text: Their blessing will last for years.

options.label: Do not look; some answers are better left in the water.

outcomes.text: As you walk on, you all feel that someone, somewhere, approves.
